profile_text: Based in Düsseldorf, Germany, this catering company specializes in delivering high-quality food services for events and occasions, leveraging its expertise to provide tailored solutions. With a focus on exceptional cuisine, it has established itself as a trusted partner for discerning clients, although it has experienced a 10% decline in employees since the baseline. As a scaler in the accommodation and food service activities sector, it continues to navigate the market with 18 employees in 2024.
